description: Release travelers and work instructions through MES; send NC programs to 32 CNC machines through DNC; machine and assemble parts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $272K of shipments per production day; prime on-time delivery ratings; running jobs continue from controller memory for about one shift; a lost or altered NC program can crash a machine
manual_workaround: Printed job packets and paper travelers from the Quality Manager's controlled copies; machines finish jobs already loaded; defer new setups
dependent_people_or_facilities: Machine operators; Manufacturing Systems Engineer; shop floor

description: First article inspection; CMM and in-process inspection; certificates of conformance; nonconformance records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Parts cannot ship without inspection records; an inspection record error could let a nonconforming flight part reach an aircraft; AS9100 and prime quality clauses require records
manual_workaround: Manual inspection with calibrated hand gauges for simple features; paper inspection reports entered later; hold shipments of parts that need CMM
dependent_third_parties: Prime A and Prime B quality portals

description: Receive customer models; create and revise drawings; release engineering changes in PLM
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Released jobs keep running; new orders and engineering changes wait; customer change deadlines are usually measured in days
manual_workaround: Work locally on CAD workstations and check in after recovery; no release of new revisions until PLM returns

description: Create and prove NC programs; write work instructions; plan routings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New setups need released NC programs; about 3 new part numbers start each week; wrong program revision is a safety and quality risk
manual_workaround: Run proven programs already in DNC; postpone new part introductions

business_process: CUI exchange with primes and outside processors
description: Download drawings and models from the Prime A portal; exchange files with Prime B and 3 outside processors over SFTP; CUI email
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New orders and changes arrive through these paths; outside processors need drawings with parts; files are also held by the sender and can be sent again
manual_workaround: Prime A portal from any enclave laptop; controlled paper copies travel with parts to outside processors; ask partners to re-send files
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-03 (virtual desktops, SFTP gateway); SYS-12; SYS-01
dependent_third_parties: Prime A portal; Prime B; outside processors

description: Enter customer orders; release work orders to MES; buy material and outside processing; track inventory
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Work order release and material purchases stop; late material orders delay the schedule by the supplier lead time
manual_workaround: Printed open-order, schedule, and inventory reports (run weekly); phone and email purchase orders logged for later entry

description: Receive material; pack and ship finished parts with certificates of conformance; invoice
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Revenue is recognized at shipment (about $272K per production day); prime delivery ratings affect future awards
manual_workaround: Hand-written packing slips and certificates signed by Quality; invoice after ERP returns

business_process: Contracts, export compliance, and DoD incident reporting
description: Review flowdowns; manage export authorizations; post SPRS scores; report cyber incidents to DoD through DIBNet and notify primes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: DFARS 252.204-7012(c) requires a report within 72 hours of discovery even while systems are down; ITAR releases need export review before data leaves
manual_workaround: Report from a clean corporate endpoint with the medium assurance certificate; phone the primes' security contacts; paper export log
dependent_third_parties: DoD (DIBNet, DC3); Prime A and Prime B; forensic retainer
dependent_people_or_facilities: Contracts Manager (ITAR Empowered Official); IT Manager

description: Commercial email, time clocks for 158 production employees, sales and commercial customer contact
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Time clock gaps create payroll corrections; commercial customer quotes and schedules move by email
manual_workaround: Paper time sheets signed by supervisors; mobile phones for customer contact
dependent_third_parties: Commercial productivity SaaS provider; internet service provider

description: Payroll processing; onboarding; terminations (which also trigger enclave account removal)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs weekly for production staff; a missed payroll has legal and retention effects; termination notices must still reach IT the same day
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider; phone termination notices to the IT Manager
